note: Embedded NUL, construction and length in one: `\0` inside a string literal. Emacs reads it as one character among three and answers (3 "a\0b"), the NUL printed as itself. kg never reaches the expression -- fe's reader refuses the escape by name, `unsupported read syntax: NUL character in string`, because `BuildString` writes at `strlen` and a stored NUL would silently shift every later character down. Compared by the message-source fallback, since a reader error happens before kgbatch's Lisp wrapper.
